facts.fact: 王国总动员：信号塔+号角+全国上武；大火扑向首都；「the land is raining backward」——Reynolds+Percival 两个 Glacian 合力把沼泽与 Lake Virell 整体拉上天（水量之大前所未有）；「They think we are invading…It's me! It was me!」
facts.anchor: The land is raining backward—every drop falling up into the sky.

facts.fact: 国王之死：回宫见 Queen Mona 与 Evelyn 哭伏在遗体上——蓝袍、熟悉的手——King Reynolds 死了；「And it's my fault.」；Alden：「Lavina created the fire」（毫不意外）；Nash：「We always knew this was a possibility.」——她随即昏倒
facts.anchor: King Reynolds—the man I once called my uncle—is dead.

facts.fact: 黑穴噩梦：她被绑在石板上被刀切割——「Reynolds」黑衣、更强、不同——「Daughter…It's time you come to Dranderon. I won't let them keep my Little Fire.」刀抵颈——惊醒于医务室
facts.anchor: It’s time you come to Dranderon. I won’t let them keep my Little Fire.

facts.fact: 医疗线：卫兵按住四肢、Brogan 在场（面色苍白）逐根拔碎片；「Her gift works too quickly now」（愈合围着碎片长）；Stone Sickness（Cadmar 常见病）——Draven 派她的 men 去船上请医治者
facts.anchor: She deals in Stone Sickness—it’s common in Cadmar

facts.fact: 病房外的对峙与告白：Council 在决定「她是他们的什么」；王后坚称她对国王之死负责；Evelyn 的证词有力（弃马救人）；「She was failed by everyone—not the other way around」；Draven「I love her more than everything in existence」；她夜里尖叫、他抱着也无用
facts.anchor: I do. I love her more than everything in existence.

facts.fact: Death Benefit 全揭：父亲问「你小时候收过 Death Benefits？」——Constantine 的 Benefit 给了五岁的他；透过母亲的眼睛看到巨树之国、她抱着婴儿 Lavina、血下露出与他镜像相同的印记——「I knew」；母亲遗言「Love her」两男同声说出；Draven 当成命令（找到她、爱她）——父亲补充「she didn't know who Lavina's father was」——她滑回昏迷前只抓到半句
facts.anchor: Her mother left the Death Benefit to you, didn’t she?
